text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
And in the 'Labyrinth Escape Audition'! 
The first ones to reach the checkpoint are 
Team King Halo and Sweep Tosho!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant*—Not bad...!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Naturally! I am—*pant*—of the highest 
caliber, after all!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Alright, alright, stop bickering, you two. 
We need to find out what we're supposed to 
do here—

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Allow me to explain that!! 
Welcome to Checkpoint 1, my little rough 
diamonds!

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Here, our little rough diamonds will each 
be asked to choose a memorable race!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Huh? What do you mean, a memorable race?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I'm guessing it's the checkpoint's 
'challenge', right? 
Look, they prepared something like this 
over here—

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, correct! 
Truth be told, this audition's motif is 
themed after wedding reception 
preparations! ♪

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
So for our first checkpoint, each of you 
will choose a single memorable race that 
conveys your feelings!

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Titled—Convey your feelings to the one you 
want to show!! 
'A Memorable Race: The Path I Run'~~!!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Hmm—so basically, it's like those 
self-introduction profile videos they 
always play at wedding receptions?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Then we can't just pick any random race, 
right? 
It needs to be something truly meaningful—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Hmph. Well, I'm not picking one.

text_block_list.name: King & Sky
text_block_list.text:
Eh? 
Huh?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Because picking a 'memorable race' is 
totally ridiculous.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
From here on out, I'm going to run even 
more amazing races, you know! 
There's no point in showing off old ones!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I'll show everyone a truly magical race 
once I become a full-fledged witch!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...A-And off she goes.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well, isn't that fine too? That's its own 
form of self-expression.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: —Self-expression... Yes, indeed.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"What is being asked in this audition 
is... 
Who I want to show my racewear to, and how 
I want them to see me—"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"If that's the case, there is only one 
memorable race I want to show. 
Ms. Beauty, play this!"

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
"‘All righty~♪ ...Wait, my, you've chosen 
quite an unexpected race, haven't you?’"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: "Huh, King!? Don't tell me that race is—"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"No need for disbelief—that's right. 
The Classic Triple Crown's 'Kikka-sho', 
the race where I lost to you."

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"‘Now, the 'Kikka-sho' enters its final 
stage! 
In the lead is Seiun Sky! Seiun Sky is out 
in front!’"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"‘A determined breakaway, with the chasers 
hot on her heels! 
Yet Seiun Sky holds on, she stubbornly 
holds on! Crossing the line first is—!’"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: ‘SEIUN SKYYYY!!!!’

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
"‘Tell me, darling: why did you 
intentionally choose a race you lost?’"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Because this is where my beginning lies—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Back then, I felt backed into a corner. 
I couldn't produce satisfying results 
along the classic royal road that didn't 
suit my aptitudes."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, I convinced myself that this was 
the only way to earn recognition. 
That if I won along the royal road 
everyone longed for, even Mother would 
surely acknowledge me..."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"So I gave it everything I had. 
I pushed myself as hard as I possibly 
could, piling up effort after effort—"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: And yet—... I lost.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Even in the final leg of the Triple Crown, 
the 'Kikka-sho', I couldn't win...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"However, losing the 'Kikka-sho' 
finally woke me up to reality."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: King...?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I was always swayed by my mother's 
"brilliant talent"—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Yet my classmate who won that day 
kept her eyes fixed carefully, directly on 
the 'brilliant talents' around her."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Without being blinded by their 
brilliance, 
she worked out her own way forward with 
her own strength."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Watching her, I was finally able to let 
go 
of my obsession with the royal road."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"I found the resolve to accept that 
I had no choice but to find my own way to 
shine."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
That is why this race was my true 
beginning—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"It was the very first step toward 
becoming the master of my own fate... 
Toward becoming King!"

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
"A record of the birth of the current 
you—indeed, 
it is truly fitting footage for your 
memorable race..."

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
"Fabulous, King Halo-chan! 
You pass the 1st Checkpoint with flying 
colors!!"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: "Ohohoho! What did I tell you?!"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"King is no longer just first-class! 
I am beyond first-class—I am 
world-class!!"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Come, let's get going, Sky-san! 
With this momentum, we'll clear the next 
checkpoint in no time!"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
(The "resolve" to shine on one's own path, 
huh...)

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
............She really got me with that 
one.
